_note: The tables a run is rolled from. See NORTHSTAR.md, docs/RACE_BRIEF.md and
docs/WORLD_FORMULA.md (the climate space).
THE FORMULA: every biome, enemy and boss occupies a RANGE on four axes --
heat  0 frozen . 1 cool . 2 warm . 3 molten
light 0 abyssal . 1 dim . 2 lit . 3 radiant
wet   0 arid . 1 damp . 2 soaked . 3 submerged
depth 0 sky/orbit . 1 surface . 2 underground . 3 abyss
Two things are compatible iff their ranges OVERLAP ON EVERY AXIS. That one
interval test replaces any hand-authored NxN mixing matrix: lava[3,3] and
forest[1,2] can never share a heat value, so they never mix; caves span
heat[1,3] because underground is insulated, so icy caves, forest caves and
lava caves all fall out of the same rule with no special cases.
Regions compose as PRIMARY + ACCENTS: the primary carries the world (and
must be wired -- have real terrain art); accents are compatible guests and
may be unwired scaffolds. Enemies BELONG where they overlap the primary;
the regular roster is exactly the compatible set. Bosses INVERT the rule:
the rolled boss comes from the INCOMPATIBLE set, because a boss should
read as an intruder -- something the world did not produce.
Wiring honesty, so nothing here reads as a promise the code does not keep:
biomes[].wired      true = has terrain art (a LEVEL_TERRAIN key in
ground.gd) and may roll as primary. false = design
scaffold; may appear as an accent only.
enemies[].scene     REAL -- must load. The roster filter in main.gd
matches on these paths.
bosses[]            Tagged and rolled (boss_id on the manifest) but the
BOSS_SCHEDULE in main.gd is NOT yet driven by it.
modifiers[].wired   true = effects are applied by main.gd. false = rolls
and displays but changes nothing yet.
races[].planned     NOT BUILT -- design capture; never offered.

lines: They pushed the cybernetics until the wetware answered back.
What answered was the Rift. It had been there the whole time.
By the next quarter it had a line item.
The noticing was patented within the hour.
The consciousness of the world was surveyed, valued, and depreciated
You are the equipment sent to protect the write-down.
An implant carried a signal it was never specified to carry.
The engineers called it a fault until Legal called it an opportunity.
You are standing inside the fault.

biomes.blurb: The insulation of the world. Anything can be down here, and is.

biomes.name: The Overexposure
biomes.blurb: There is no shade, and nothing that needed shade survived.
